description: Address all issues from the semantic code review: fix script injection vulnerability in kiro.yml, correct agent name inconsistency in agents.md documentation, add agent name validation, handle multiline comment bodies safely, and add a clarifying comment for non-comment triggers.
steps: Fix script injection in .github/workflows/kiro.yml by replacing direct interpolation of github.event.comment.body with an env: block
Handle multiline comment bodies by reading only the first line for routing and passing the full body as the prompt
Add agent name validation step that checks the parsed name against the known list of 11 agents
Fix agent name inconsistency in .kiro/steering/agents.md - change 'researcher' to 'devops' in the agent-dependency-audit.yml row
Add a clarifying comment in kiro.yml for the non-comment trigger path
acceptance_criteria: github.event.comment.body is never directly interpolated in a run: step
Comment body is passed via env: block for safe shell handling
Multiline comments do not break the parsing logic
Agent names are validated against the known list before invocation
Documentation correctly states devops for agent-dependency-audit.yml
Non-comment trigger path has a comment explaining its behavior
verification: Verify kiro.yml does not contain '${{ github.event.comment.body }}' inside a run: block
Verify kiro.yml uses env: COMMENT_BODY for comment body handling
Verify agents.md references devops for dependency audit workflow
